verdict.rationale: The only first-party mention of action-item extraction is an API use case (docs-53) describing tasks a developer could build into Linear/Jira. That is a developer building block, not a native capability. Nothing in the evidence documents that Granola's auto-generated enhanced notes extract action items with owners or collect them in a trackable list. A PM's report that action items 'slipped through' and needed a self-built kanban app (comm-7) is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.
